patterns.note: Sections utilize full-width background colors that alternate between various shades of green, beige, and dark teal to create distinct visual breaks and rhythm.
A clear typographic hierarchy is established with large, bold sans-serif headings for main sections, supported by smaller, often uppercase, labels and legible body text.
The site employs an earthy and natural color palette, predominantly featuring various shades of green, a warm beige, and a deep teal, complemented by white and dark text for contrast.
The main navigation bar shrinks in height and gains a solid background color as the user scrolls down, becoming sticky at the top of the viewport.
The hero background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content as the user scrolls.
Feature and service offerings are presented in clean, grid-based card layouts with consistent padding and iconography or simple text labels.

technique_notes: The site uses scroll-triggered animations for section reveals, where elements appear to fade in and slide up from the bottom as they enter the viewport. The hero background image employs a subtle parallax effect, moving at a slower rate than the foreground content. The main navigation bar dynamically transforms on scroll, reducing its height and transitioning from a transparent to a solid background color once it passes the initial hero section, then remaining fixed at the top.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (H1 ~3-4x body) with clear, readable body text and smaller, often uppercase, supporting labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons, input fields, and card elements, contributing to a soft, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, creating a sense of calm and professionalism.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a sophisticated, earthy color palette, particularly the varied greens and warm beige, combined with a clean, modern layout, creates a professional yet approachable aesthetic. The subtle parallax on the hero and the transforming sticky navigation add a polished, high-quality feel without being overly flashy.
